en: A black‑and‑white image showing a cloister garden attached to a Gothic building. Pointed arches supported by columns are visible on the right, one column heavily covered with ivy. Above is a steep tiled roof with a small dormer window. The foreground contains dense plants and ferns, with a dirt path curving through the courtyard and a pile of rubble or stones on the right, suggesting partial damage or restoration. The scene is enclosed by stone walls and arcades typical of a medieval monastery or church.
